subject: BrightRoot renewal & expansion — pricing path
messages:
From: Asha Reddy <asha@brightroot.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@brightroot.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightRoot renewal & expansion — pricing path

Sean / Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We ran the numbers with our engineering and procurement leads and want to both renew the core instance and add an additional 350k embedding units + two more concurrent inference nodes for Q3. High-level asks from our side:

- Hold current enterprise per-token pricing for the renewal (we're targeting a start date of Aug 1) for at least 90 days while internal approvals finish.
- One-time credit to offset last quarter's burst (est. $18k) — we'd like that reflected in the renewal quote.
- Request a staged commit: 12-month minimum with an optional uplift window at month 6 instead of an immediate multi-year lock.

Can you send a formal options sheet with 1) conservative (minimal uplift + 60 day hold) and 2) growth (12-month commit + 10% committed discount) — and include any onboarding credits for capacity spikes? Procurement (cc'd) will need a PO path and a DocuSign-ready addendum.

Attached: PO_20260620_BrightRoot.pdf (procurement placeholder)

Thanks — happy to take a 30-minute sync tomorrow afternoon.

—Asha
Asha Reddy
Head of Platform, BrightRoot Labs
asha@brightroot.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Reddy <asha@brightroot.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@brightroot.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightRoot renewal & expansion — pricing path

Asha — thanks for the clear summary. We can absolutely support the planned expansion; appreciate the PO stub. Quick notes/initial offer outline before I loop legal and ops:

- Price hold: we can offer a firm 60-day price hold from the date of the quote (we'll add language for an extension to 90 days if contract goes to signature within 30 additional days, subject to standard exception).
- Credits: we can apply a one-time $20k credit to offset last quarter's burst (slightly above your estimate) if BrightRoot signs a 12-month commit. Alternate: $12k credit with a 6-month commit.
- Commit structure options: 12-month firm commit with 10% discount on committed units OR a flexible staged commit (6-month review with uplift option) with a 6% baseline discount.
- Capacity uplift: we'll include a temporary burst buffer (30% headroom) for 90 days post-go-live to smooth the transition.

I'm attaching an initial options sheet (BR_Renewal_Draft_20260621.pdf) with the two tracks you requested. Marissa / Monica — can you prep a polished commercial with explicit line items (committed units, overage rate, credit application, and DocuSign-ready addendum)? Irene, please confirm there are no outstanding security artifacts procurement will need beyond SOC2 report link — I'll get that over once you confirm.

Propose a quick call Tue 3pm PT to walk options. If that works, I'll send calendar invite.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: BR_Renewal_Draft_20260621.pdf

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 13:10:00 -07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: BrightRoot commercial options (please action)

Team — moving this to internal to get a tight set of options for BrightRoot (they asked for both conservative and growth tracks). Deliverables needed by EOD Tue so I can present on Wed: 

- Marissa: Draft two clean quotes (PDF) —
  * Option A (Conservative): 6-month staged commit, 6% committed discount, $12k one-time credit, price-hold 60 days.
  * Option B (Growth): 12-month commit, 10% committed discount, $20k one-time credit, price-hold 90 days.
  Include line-by-line: committed embedding units, inference nodes, monthly invoice cadence, overage rate, and the mechanism for applying the credit.

- Monica: Ops checklist — confirm ability to provision +2 inference nodes by Aug 1, confirm the 30% burst buffer for 90 days, and estimate any incremental infra run-rate that should be surfaced in the quote.

- Irene: Security/compliance — procurement asked for SOC2 evidence and a standard data retention statement. Can you attach the latest SOC2 report link and a short paragraph we can paste into the addendum?

Notes on negotiation flexibility: we can trade an extended price-hold (90 days) for an explicit 12-month commit or a $10k smaller credit. If procurement pushes for PO-only acceptance (no signature), include a clause that auto-applies the credit on first invoice and the price-hold terminates after 30 days.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/BR-2026-045 — please update deal stage to "proposal" and add line items when ready.

Thanks — Marissa please own the doc and share the PDF to drive.

—Sean

From: Asha Reddy <asha@brightroot.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@brightroot.com>, procurement@brightroot.com
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightRoot renewal & expansion — pricing path

Sean / team — appreciate the quick turnaround and the higher credit. BrightRoot is comfortable moving to a 12-month commit if we get the 90-day price-hold in writing and the $20k credit applied on execution. Two items from procurement:

1) We need a DocuSign addendum with the price-hold language and credit schedule (can you send the DocuSign link after you share final wording?).
2) Procurement will need SOC2 and the short data-retention blurb (Irene, copying you directly in my head).

If you can send the polished Option B PDF + DocuSign by EOD Wed we can circulate internally and aim to sign next week. Quoted below is our PO reference (attached earlier).
